correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed 16 listed facets, 24 edges and 16 face-evenness equations. Reimplemented GF(2) Gaussian elimination gives face-equation rank 15, so Z¹ has dimension 9 and EXACTLY 512 cocycles, and vertex coboundaries rank7 give 128 coboundaries and H¹ dimension2 with exactly three nonzero cosets. Exhaustively enumerated all 512 cocycles, partitioned by 128-element coboundary cosets, evaluated Alexander–Whitney mod2 cup square on fundamental facet chain and support minima: exactly (5,1,1), (6,5,0), (6,3,1). Independently checked explicit unique weight-five support and connectivity/degree-2 for all nine minimizers in the dual cubic graph: each is a simple dual cycle. This independent complete enumeration proves the exact finite theorem; no extrapolation or verifier-log-only inference. Correctness of labeling as Cervone’s 1133 is supported by the primary classification.

It separates the three nonzero classes by both shortest dual-cycle length and multiplicity and links them to the cohomological cup-square quadratic type, supplying a reusable exact surface/coding benchmark. One canonical finite object and an exhaustive proof are acceptable without any conjectured infinite-family theorem.
